node.statement: Product defect: for U,V in calU and X=U bold-dot V, the involution axiom gives X^dagger=V^dagger bold-dot U^dagger. Two applications of the associator axiom compare (V^dagger bold-dot U^dagger) bold-dot (U bold-dot V) first with ((V^dagger bold-dot U^dagger) bold-dot U) bold-dot V and then with (V^dagger bold-dot (U^dagger bold-dot U)) bold-dot V=J. The product-norm axiom and 1.2.1 therefore give ||X^dagger bold-dot X-J||<=2*epsilon_r*(1+epsilon_r)||U||^2||V||^2<=(544/225)*epsilon_r<=3*epsilon_r.
